title: Queens Public Library ransomware attack: library says virtually all services restored
date_note: NY1 says the library first reported a systemwide outage on Wednesday 4 November; QNS dates identification of the attack to 4 November.
place: Queens, New York, United States (library system serving the borough)
geo_basis: borough served by the library system; headquarters address not read
summary: NY1 and QNS report a ransomware attack on the Queens Public Library, first identified on 4 November. QNS reports library president Dennis Walcott said "we are back online and have restored virtually all our services"; the online Contact Us and interlibrary loan features remain unavailable. QNS says it is not yet known whether personal information was taken; the library told customers it will notify affected individuals if it learns that it was.
plain: Queens Public Library says it is back online and has restored virtually all services after a reported ransomware attack. Some online features are still unavailable, and it is not yet known whether personal information was taken.
exec: A US public library system says virtually all services are back after a reported ransomware attack; whether personal data was taken is not yet known, according to QNS.
impact: QNS (23 Nov): library says virtually all services restored, including printing, databases, public computers, website and app; Contact Us and interlibrary loan features still unavailable; earlier book requests and calendar entries may be missing or outdated.

sources.name: QNS: Queens Public Library restores nearly all public tech services after cyberattack

validation.note: NY1 (5 Nov) and QNS (18 Nov) are independent publishers that each describe a ransomware attack on the library; NY1 quotes the NYPD calling it a cybersecurity incident. Neither article quotes the library itself using the word ransomware, so status stays developing. Neither says whether patron data was accessed. QNS (23 Nov) quotes the library CEO on restoration and says it is not yet known whether personal information was taken.

review.note: Re-read NY1 (5 Nov), QNS (18 Nov) and QNS (23 Nov): ransomware label, 4 Nov date, Walcott quote, restored services, unavailable features, personal data unknown and notification wording all match; status developing fits
